# CoFID 2021 excerpt

`cofid2021_excerpt.xlsx` contains the three header rows and 10 food rows of the sheets
"1.2 Factors", "1.3 Proximates", "1.4 Inorganics", "1.5 Vitamins" and "1.6 Vitamin Fractions"
from McCance and Widdowson's The Composition of Foods Integrated Dataset 2021
(`McCance_Widdowsons_Composition_of_Foods_Integrated_Dataset_2021..xlsx`, downloaded 2026-10-30
from https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/composition-of-foods-integrated-dataset-cofid).

Foods: 14-319 apples, 14-031 dried apricots, 13-669 (twice: aubergine and watercress share this
code in the published file), 19-500 bacon, 17-506 bitter, 11-742 fortified cornflakes, 17-222 dry
cider, 12-596 whole milk, 13-490 boiled potatoes.

One value was changed to exercise the bracketed-estimate marker: vitamin C of 13-490 is `(9)`
instead of `9`. Everything else is copied unchanged.

Public Health England (2021) McCance and Widdowson's The Composition of Foods Integrated Dataset.
